Enable iTRAK mover recovery on Energizing 5.0 - Renamed AOI from RecoverEnable.
============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Enable Recovery of Movers on Energize. When recovery is enabled and movers energized, all movers selected by instances of raM_Opr_iTRAK_RecoverZone. will be recovered.. Enabling this feature will store the last valid position when the mover is de-energized.
Instruction Execution: -----
Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Description 1002 Device Handler faulted 1003 Device Handler is not in a supported state. Device Handler must be in state Available
Revision Notes: ----- 5.0 - AOI only enables recovery. Removed user input to enable or disable recovery. 4,0 - Renamed Add-On Instruction 1.0. - Release
